narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic storytelling piece satirizing stock market investment behavior. It depicts a 'know-it-all' investor encouraging others to buy TSMC stock during a dip, only to show the subsequent financial loss and emotional breakdown as both TSMC and Tesla stocks crash, ultimately mocking the hubris of amateur traders.
